about: a glassy blue shield bubble: it grows in, shimmers, flashes when hit and pops

animations.name: up
animations.about: the bubble grows out of a spark, overshoots, settles and materialises into the idle bubble: its last frame is idle's first (plays once; then play idle)

animations.name: idle
animations.about: the bubble shimmers: its rim churns, glints twinkle inside and motes drift round it (seamless loop)

animations.name: hit
animations.about: an overlay: play it once on a second sprite over the looping idle, at the same centre. A blow lands on the upper right: the rim there flares, a shock ring pulses round the bubble and a few sparks fly (plays once, ends empty)

animations.name: pop
animations.about: the bubble flashes, cracks and bursts into motes (plays once, ends empty)
